construction.operation: Null/float-NaN normalization, stripped string values, joined in field order with a vertical-bar delimiter
construction.a_name: Normalized model-name field pooled as a lookup key
construction.source_meaning: The producing table reader constructs full keys from public subject metadata. The frozen predictor uses a_full/full and a_name/normalized_name for subject prior lookup. This static source role does not itself prove exact public-row membership.

descriptive_identity_notes.qualification: A descriptive identity note is retained inside a composite public subject configuration key; it is not claimed to be a bare model identifier.

component_qualifications.interpretation: Every hit is within the subject/model lookup key dictionaries. Composite subject keys retain metadata labels, source references, settings, and a descriptive identity note. No arbitrary release prose, configuration comment, or code comment is waived by this result.

existing_conflict_receipt.comparison: Exact multiset equality of key SHA and both casefold pattern flags; original location hashes are retained on every new record.

public_subject_row_membership.qualification: Composite identifiers retain all public subject metadata fields, including descriptive identity notes; membership does not assert the resolved identity of an uncertain model.

release_text_and_path_scan.qualification: Executed immediately before these audit receipts were written. The new receipts and verifier omit raw identifier strings; future source changes require a fresh scan.
